title: Project Eleven Acquires Riva Labs to Scale Post-Quantum Cryptography and Blockchain Infrastructure Stack - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Post-quantum security firm Project Eleven acquired Riva Labs to integrate hash-based PQ signatures, PQ MPC, account abstraction and hardware signing across Ethereum and other L1s, using AI-assisted cryptanalysis to build crypto-agile migration frameworks against Shor's-algorithm threats to ECDSA/Schnorr.

insights.claim: Public-ledger public-key cryptography, predominantly ECDSA and Schnorr signatures, remains susceptible to Shor's algorithm running on fault-tolerant quantum computers.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The quantum threat to crypto asset signatures is driving a dedicated PQ-blockchain security market.

insights.claim: Rather than isolated signature-layer patches, the combined pipeline integrates post-quantum primitives across key management, smart-contract wallets and protocol-level consensus rules.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Full-stack PQ migration implies deeper protocol changes for blockchains like Ethereum than a simple signature swap.
insights.quote: Rather than applying isolated algorithmic patches at the signature layer

insights.claim: Project Eleven acquired Riva Labs, consolidating IP in hash-based PQ signatures, post-quantum MPC, account abstraction and hardware signing across Ethereum and primary Layer-1 ecosystems.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Early M&A shows consolidation in the niche PQ crypto-security sector.

insights.claim: A focus is practical, low-overhead post-quantum signing on consumer-grade hardware to preserve backward compatibility and throughput across decentralized networks.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Wallet/hardware vendors will need PQ upgrades; performance overhead is the key adoption hurdle.
insights.locator: A key focus of the acquisition

insights.claim: Riva Labs' AI-driven methodology automates cryptographic research, cryptanalysis and code validation to build agile migration frameworks that can adapt as NIST lattice and hash-based standards evolve.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: AI-assisted cryptanalysis could compress security research cycles, an AI-crypto convergence play.
insights.quote: deploying automated artificial intelligence tools to accelerate cryptographic research, cryptanalysis, and code validation
insights.locator: A key focus of the acquisition
